overview_description:
I build Salesforce Field Service for organizations whose revenue depends on getting the right person to the right address at the right time.

Most field scheduling breaks the same way. Capacity is set at the shift level. Travel time is a guess. Every appointment is booked at the same length whether it is a ten-minute measurement or a two-hour consultation.

WHAT I BUILD
- Appointment-based availability that replaces fixed shifts
- Drive-time models with per-resource overrides
- Overbooking and capacity engines honouring multiple shifts and break gaps
- Appointment duration driven by territory, with qualifying questions that route the right type
- External scheduling APIs so partner channels book into the same model

WINDOWS USA
I replaced fixed-shift scheduling across their whole field organisation. It runs across 407 territories and 163 field resources on a base of 725,000+ service appointments, and booked over 6,400 in its first weeks live. Measured from their production org, August 2026.

I am a Salesforce Consulting Partner and I do the build myself. Fixed-cost pricing settles scope before work starts. Customer satisfaction across scored engagements is 4.78 out of 5.

overview_title: Marketing Cloud Account Engagement
overview_description:
Cloud Blazing is born from one of the original members of Salesforce’s in-house Pardot Implementation Team. We love Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (formally Pardot) and Sales Cloud. Our mission is to make you and your Team proud adopters of Salesforce, and absolute Rockstars. 

What we do:

**Account Engagement Implementations**
This is our jam and we learned how to do The OG Implementation in-house, at Salesforce. We will get you up and running the best way.

**Account Engagement Migration**
You started your email and/or marketing automation journey with a Mailchimp, a Hubspot, or dare we say it, a Marketo. Fear not, we will joyfully, and seamlessly transition you.

**Marketing and Sales Training**
Whether you’re new to Marketing Automation, are well versed, we will meet you where you are and get you to a great place. We also work with Sales Team to show them how to leverage Account Engagement in Salesforce.

**Marketing Operations Support**
And this is where we really shine; imagine a world where you had your very own MOps person. You want it, we got it. And if we don’t, we will figure it out.

overview_title: Peakforce
overview_description:
Peakforce Solutions LLC was founded to provide a focus on SMB organizations needing technology and strategic consulting usually reserved for the larger organization. 

We realize that many SMB firms are not seeing the expected business outcomes from their implementations and have been priced out of the market by many consultants going up market.  Our goal is to provide the high quality consulting usually reserved for those companies bringing a disciplined approach with the flexibility required for SMB firms to achieve the desired outcomes. 

Our team has been able to bring together planning and implementation frameworks from over 25 years of experience; We bring expertise in process consulting, roadmap development, project planning and project management.  This coupled with our technology expertise including but not limited to Salesforce Configuration, Apex, API, LWC with significant expertise in Core Clouds, ARM (Revenue Cloud), Agentforce, and Mulesoft provides a comprehensive solution provider for the SMB.

Our goal is to allow you to focus on what you do best and grow your business; let us help enable you. We will help you elevate your business, achieve your peak.

We'll start by understanding where you need help. If you have pain-points, we'll start there and get those eliminated as quickly as possible. Or if your system is already running smoothly, but you want to expand it to streamline additional business processes, we'd be happy to build that for you!

Quality over Quantity: We believe in doing things right, right off the bat. Our formalized testing methodology is how we 'shift left' - shortening the time and effort from initial concepts to reality in Production.

The ICI Promise: Treat your Org as if it was our own. Treat your Data as if it was our own.

2. Hire an expensive Salesforce Consulting Firm that is not consistently engaged with the business and the evolution of the platform. Different users may provide support, so they have to re-learn the Org each time they engage. Result is an expensive engagement without the longstanding results.

The Solution?  Mercury CRM Solutions

overview_title: HiFi Consulting Group
overview_description:
It’s not about us. It’s about you.

Maybe you have a backlog of important features and need custom Salesforce development. Maybe you need to get your team engaged, moving faster, and more successful at delivering value through strategic consulting services.

We’ll meet you where you’re at and get you where you need to go. Key principles we operate by:

Great tech teams partner with the business.
 - The best tech solutions come from a deep understanding of mission & vision.
 - Every team needs an excellent translator that speaks both business and tech.
 - Tech teams treated like cost centers will not generate transformational change.

Continuity is an accelerator for progress.
 - The more sustained the engagement, the faster & better the outcomes.
 - Orgs can’t have every tech skill on staff. HiFi fills the gaps with consistency.
 - The inefficiency of one-off project overhead erases value.

Tech services are expensive. We must deliver value.
 - Move quickly, prototype often, use only the resources you need when you need them. 
 - And remember, good planning saves money.

Tech must be open, honest, and full of good listeners.

overview_description:
Most Salesforce projects fail the same two ways. They go live months late, and when they finally do, the business can't change anything without calling a developer. We built Campfire Solutions to fix both.

We're a Philadelphia based implementation partner for owners and operations leaders at small and mid-sized companies, doing a first build or rescuing one that stalled.

We start with your process, not the software. We map how work actually moves through your business, then design around it, so it actually gets used.

We deploy a proven foundation, so you go live in weeks, not months. You aren't paying us to reinvent stage gates, approvals, notifications, and quoting from scratch. An architect leads every project.

You own everything we build. No managed package, no license fee, no black box. It's standard Salesforce your own admin can adjust and extend after we leave. One time cost, no monthly fees, no lock-in.

Sales Cloud: pipeline, forecasting, approvals, quoting and quote documents. Service Cloud: support plus internal operations like onboarding, finance intake, and deal desk. Also data migration and training.

Book a free strategy session at campfiresolutions.io.

Our team spent decades inside the industry, working with some of the world's largest hotel brands to implement, operate and support their Salesforce solutions. We arrive knowing how a property runs and where the operational pain sits.

AI is where most hotel technology conversations start these days, and where most projects stall. Industry research puts the share of companies getting real financial return from AI at only around one percent, and the reason is almost always the same: the data layer was never ready. We work in the opposite order. We assess what your guest and operational data can support, get that foundation right, then design AI & Salesforce solutions that have somewhere solid to start from.

We also build. hotelPROPEL is our accelerator platform for hotel operations: properties and rooms, housekeeping assignment and inspection, maintenance work orders, guest requests and preferences, a frontline board built on low-cost licenses, and a virtual agent phone channel for staff or guests to report issues.

The architecture standard
Every RI product ships with the same foundation: 2GP managed package, OWD Private on sensitive objects, Apex triggers for all safety-critical compliance logic, Custom Metadata Types for configuration, immutable audit log per product, Platform Events for Agentforce invocation, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions. This isn't a differentiator — it's the baseline every product has to meet before it ships.

RI takes on a limited number of consulting engagements per year. Core focus areas: Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce implementation, complex org architecture, and AppExchange product development for other ISVs. Engagements are scoped directly with the principal — no account management layer, no handoff to a junior team.

Our process is simple.  We listen and then we solve problems together with our clients.  Sometimes customers need the applications we have already built and sometimes there are custom projects needed to meet unique business challenges.

overview_description:
Cloud Structures delivers implementation, migration, and modernization services for Salesforce. We work with teams that need a reliable CRM foundation, clean data, and a delivery partner who can own architecture and execution.

What we do:
• New implementations and rebuilds (Sales, Service, Experience)
• Data migrations and org consolidations (mapping, cleansing, dedupe, cutover)
• Automation and productivity (Flows, approvals, routing, Omni-Channel setup)
• Integrations (APIs, middleware, ERP/accounting, identity)
• DevOps and release management (environments, CI/CD, testing, governance)
• Performance and technical debt cleanup (stability, maintainability, speed)

How we deliver:
• Fast discovery with clear scope, risks, and a realistic plan
• Senior-level solution design with security and scale in mind
• Iterative build with demos, tight feedback loops, and documentation
• Clean handoff: admin enablement, runbooks, and post-launch support

If you have a stalled project, messy data, low adoption, or an upcoming migration, we can step in quickly, stabilize the platform, and get you to a dependable release cadence.

overview_description:
Regardless of industry, businesses require an effective process for managing customer interactions. With Salesforce, your business can transform how you engage with prospects, customers and partners.

But implementing Salesforce can be a complex process. Migrating data from legacy CRMs or other data sources and customizing the solution to meet your organization’s individual needs are just two of the many complex adoption processes.

All Covered offers expert guidance throughout the implementation process. Blending extensive platform knowledge with industry experience, we provide expert consulting services that encompass the following areas:

Strategy
All Covered will work with your staff to understand your challenges and objectives and use our in-depth knowledge of the Salesforce platform to design a solution that meets your specific business needs.

Deployment

Strong

At Learn to CRM, our mission is to help businesses of all sizes unlock the full value of their CRM by combining proven customer relationship strategies with the power of AI. Our solutions grow revenue, cut wasted time, and create exceptional customer experiences—no matter which CRM you use.

Throughout my career, I’ve helped companies of all sizes streamline operations and accelerate growth across hundreds of projects in various industries. Time and again, I’ve seen the same challenges: overly complicated software, AI tools that feel disconnected from the real workflow, data you can’t trust, and processes that rely on ‘duct-taping’ multiple systems together.

overview_description:
Because Salesforce/Force.com seems easy to set up, it is easy to do wrong. You need to plan right, set it up right, train right, use it right. To do all this requires a combination of business and Salesforce.com knowledge.

We can help you if you:

-Are just starting and want expert help in the implementation (“Let’s do it right from the beginning”)
-Have started implementing Salesforce.com and now say “Wait, this is deeper than we expected”
-Are using it and are frustrated (“it’s so complex and time-consuming to use,” “I don’t get enough value from it,” “Our data is a mess,” “I can’t get the information I want,” “There must be more to Salesforce.com than this,” “Is Salesforce.com just hype?”)
-Have salesforce and it’s fine and now want to do more (“We’re ready to expand our use and we don’t have the knowledge or resources to do it”)
-Are thinking about using Salesforce.com or Force.com and want help making the decision (“Is Saleforce.com or Force.com right for my organization? – how do I decide?”)

Dorset Consulting will provide expert and dedicated assistance to respond to these needs.

overview_description:
With a combined experience of 30 years in Salesforce, we bring unparalleled insights, architecture and software development to the table. With such a rich history as Salesforce alumni, we've not only witnessed the evolution of Salesforce but actively contributed to its growth.

Specialties:
CPQ, Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service Lightning FSL, Sales Cloud, Communities, Health Cloud HLS, Health Care, & Digital Transformation

Strategic Consulting:
We have experienced Salesforce experts, working with a variety of company models to give you a tailored assessment and analysis of your business requirements. 

System Implementation & Development:
We provide services including solution architecture, design, system integration, mobile development, and AppExchange app integration and customization. We strive for a personal experience, with rapid delivery and support to keep your systems up to date with Salesforce's Summer, Winter & Spring updates.

Data Migration:
We transform existing or old, on-prem systems to the newest Salesforce Cloud platform. We help create user friendly and streamlined business processes for greater adoption for your SFDC investment.
